_comment: The themes a reader can pick from the nav. Every colour on the site is a token; assets/themes.css gives each token a value per theme, in a block html[data-theme=<id>], and the :root block is the default below. assets/theme.js sets the attribute before the first paint from localStorage (sgit.secrets.ui.theme) or, when nothing is stored, from the reader's prefers-color-scheme. The nav picker is generated from this file by admin/build/chrome.py; tests/build/test_themes.py checks every theme here has a complete block and that no colour is written anywhere else.

themes.name: Night
themes.about: The family palette: navy surfaces, teal accent. The default.

themes.name: Day
themes.about: The same palette on white, for daylight and for printing.
